scope: Lossless snapshots of superseded plans/reports and prior journals/indexes. Historical open checkboxes retain their image/date scope; archival does not close them.

historical_open_checkboxes:
Verify real Google sign-in and a real Cloud KMS key with synthetic credentials
  when project/client resources are provided. Keep unavailable external checks open;
  offline mocks cannot close them. Test actual OKX Demo credentials only under an
  explicitly reviewed cutover, retaining prior ledger and recovery evidence.

Attribute the original historical trigger using a contemporaneous
  wait/stack witness or equivalent host/storage evidence. The matching controlled
  reproduction below establishes a mechanism, not exclusive historical attribution.

Declare a production quote-coverage SLO separating normal replacement
  gaps from permitted protective pauses before claiming uninterrupted two-sided
  coverage. Guard policy is unchanged; local improvement does not certify this SLO.

Obtain a current-image natural **spot** fill and verify its quantity/fee;
  filled-active restart across both markets is not yet proven by this run.

Obtain a clean 60-minute zero-degraded-response run if the unchanged gate
  is required; investigate a bounded reporting-specific approach before tuning.

Investigate the retained p99 episode and repeated Demo guard waits; do not
  weaken the guards or assert uninterrupted quoting based on sampled data.

Capture/reproduce the actual OKX response shape in an isolated read-safe or
  controlled Demo scenario. Do not infer that the real response contained an ID.
U0: choose the browser access route and verify it with trading stopped.

U4: build the five-screen FE MVP from the integration guide; generate client
  types from the checked OpenAPI. Test workflows with a real browser and local
  service/simulator, including auth/CORS, unknown POST outcome, superseded command,
  stale reporting, stop with held exposure, Decimal/UTC and partial reconciliation.

compaction.scope: Tracked docs/plans and reports working-tree content; Git object history and ignored build logs are not deleted.
